verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships Scheduling Links for bookings, so reminder and follow-up sequences are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence documents automated email or SMS reminders or follow-up sequences around bookings. The cited booking features cover availability, priority-based overbooking and auto-rescheduling, none of which are reminders.

support.subject: As a sales lead, automated reminder and follow-up sequences (email/SMS) fire around every booking to cut no-shows
